items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: Who's the leader? Lou Lockman. Lou Lockett. Lou Lockett.

ctx.x: How big a band was that playing for the district? Probably eight men.
That was quite usual. But I don't remember. There were a lot of halls there that had eight-piece minimums in New York. Who's the leader? Lou Lockman. Lou Lockett. Lou Lockett.
